jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:**
Brand Activation Executive

**DEPARTMENT:**
Brand

**LOCATION:**
Stamford Bridge, London

**CONTRACT:**
Permanent, Full Time

**Closing date: 2nd December**

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. In the event that we receive a large number of applications, the position may be filled before the listed closing date. To avoid missing out, please submit your application at your earliest convenience.

**JOB FUNCTION:**

The Brand Activation Executive will lead the development and delivery of high-quality activation across a portfolio of Chelsea FC’s commercial partnerships, with particular ownership of highest-level partnerships. The role will be responsible for translating partner and Club objectives into impactful campaigns that strengthen relationships, grow audiences and maximise value.

Working closely with the Brand Activation Lead and wider marketing teams, the Manager will take ownership of partner strategy, activation delivery as well as additional marketing projects outside of partnerships.

The role will also play an important leadership role within the Brand Activation team, supporting and developing Executives, driving consistent ways of working and contributing to the continued evolution of the function.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Partnership Strategy & Activation**

* Support and lead a portfolio of partnerships marketing rights, developing season-long activation strategies.
* Ensure contractual rights are delivered to a high standard, contributing to partner satisfaction.

**Campaign Delivery & Reporting**

* Support complex activation campaigns from planning through to delivery, coordinating internal and external stakeholders.
* Track activation performance throughout the season.
* Use data, insight and learnings to improve future activations and demonstrate partner value.

**Collaboration & Projects**

* Support effective collaboration across Commercial, Marketing, Creative, Content, Social, Digital, Communications, Matchday and Insights.
* Take ownership of selected projects beyond the core partnership remit, including external collaborations and celebrity & talent opportunities.
* Share best practice and improve processes and ways of working across the Brand Activation team.

**Team & Partner Management**

* Support, coach and develop Brand Activation Executives, providing clear direction and opportunities to take ownership.
* Work closely with the other Brand Activation Manager to ensure consistency, collaboration and a joined-up approach across the team.

**PERSON SPECIFICATION:**

* Experience in brand activation, partnership marketing, sponsorship or integrated marketing.
* Strong understanding of sponsorship rights and how to maximise value beyond contractual delivery.
* Strong project management and communication skills.
* Confident using data and insight to measure performance and improve activity.
* Collaborative leader with experience supporting or developing junior team members.
* Proactive, creative and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-profile environment.

**Nice to Haves**

* Educated to degree level or equivalent marketing qualification
* Experience in sport, entertainment, or lifestyle marketing
* Knowledge of international fan engagement and global brand building

**OUR EXPECTATIONS:**

* To embody the club’s BLUE behaviours (Brave, Lead, Unity, Edge) in the approach to work and interaction with others
* To adhere to the club’s policies and procedures, including Health & Safety, Financial Authorisation, Confidentiality and GDPR.
* To act as an ambassador for diversity, equality, and inclusion, and demonstrate a positive commitment by treating others fairly in line with our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion Policy and reporting any acts of discrimination through appropriate channels
* To create a safe environment and act to protect all young people and vulnerable adults that are either in your care or attending club premises, and report any concerns to the Safeguarding Lead
* To report any misconduct or suspected misconduct to the HR Department

**Our commitment to Equality, Diversity and Inclusion:**

At Chelsea we recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths and we are taking positive action to ensure our existing colleagues and job applicants can fully be themselves and bring their own unique experiences and perspectives to Chelsea FC. This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.

If you need reasonable adjustments made to the recruitment process, please reach out to your recruiter, who will be able to advise and support you.

Chelsea FC is fully committed to ensuring the safety and well-being of all children, young people and adults at risk (vulnerable groups). We therefore require all successful applicants to complete a DBS Check prior to starting employment. Depending on the role, successful applicants may also be required to undergo other child protection screening where appropriate.

This Job Description is not intended to be exhaustive; the duties and responsibilities may therefore vary over time according to the changing needs of the Club.

jobs.description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
  
  
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
  
  
**The Role**
AMD is seeking a commercially driven marketing leader to lead B2B marketing strategy and execution across Northern Europe, with a focus on the United Kingdom, Norway and Sweden. The role will develop and deliver an integrated regional marketing plan spanning Channel and Enterprise audiences, aligned with AMD’s broader EMEA business priorities.
  
  
Reporting to the EMEA B2B Marketing Lead, you will translate the overall EMEA strategy into a clear, actionable and measurable regional plan. You will partner closely with Sales leadership and connect AMD’s Business Units, central marketing functions, OEM teams, Global Account Managers, partners and agencies to deliver coordinated marketing programs across the region.
  
  
This is an opportunity for an experienced commercial marketer to shape AMD’s regional marketing approach, lead and develop a team, and use marketing to create demand, progress pipeline and support revenue growth. You will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, strong stakeholder leadership and a rigorous approach to measuring marketing performance.
  
  
**The Person**
You are a strategic and commercially minded B2B marketer who is equally comfortable setting direction and driving execution. You understand how Enterprise and Channel marketing work together to create demand and support business growth, and you bring a strong understanding of partner marketing, demand generation, events and localized marketing execution.
  
  
You are a confident communicator and relationship builder who can influence across complex, cross-functional stakeholder groups. You know how to bring clarity to competing priorities, make commercially informed decisions and translate strategy into focused execution.
  
  
As a people leader, you are comfortable coaching and developing regional marketers across Channel and Enterprise disciplines, setting clear objectives, providing direction and empowering the team to deliver results.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and lead the Northern Europe B2B marketing strategy and integrated 360-degree marketing plan across Enterprise and Channel.
* Translate EMEA B2B priorities into locally relevant programs aligned with regional market dynamics, Sales priorities, target accounts, customer needs and partner opportunities.
* Own and manage the allocated regional commercial marketing budget, measuring return on marketing investment across Channel activities and AMD-led campaigns.
* Track and evaluate marketing contribution to demand generation, pipeline progression and closed-won revenue.
* Partner closely with regional and EMEA Sales leadership to establish shared priorities, measurable objectives and clear marketing plans.
* Serve as the senior regional Marketing lead, providing strategic counsel, direction and regular updates to senior stakeholders.
* Identify commercial opportunities, market gaps and competitive risks, recommending marketing investment and activities that support AMD’s growth objectives.
* Drive effective collaboration across Sales and Marketing teams, ensuring clear ownership, alignment and timely decision-making.
* Lead regional Enterprise marketing activities designed to create awareness, engagement, qualified demand and pipeline progression.
* Lead the regional Channel marketing strategy across distributors and retailers, partnering with OEM Marketing teams and the wider ecosystem.
* Lead, coach and develop the regional marketing team, ensuring clear objectives and alignment with AMD’s commercial and route-to-market priorities.
* Partner with Channel Sales, partner teams and Business Units to develop joint go-to-market programs, enablement activities and demand-generation initiatives.
* Ensure Channel programs are commercially focused and measured against agreed pipeline, revenue and partner engagement objectives.
* Connect Enterprise and Channel initiatives where appropriate to strengthen customer reach, partner participation and overall regional impact.
* Travel up to 25% of the time.

**Preferred Experience**

* B2B marketing experience within the semiconductor, high-tech or broader technology industry; experience gained within an agency environment supporting relevant technology clients is also valued.
* Strong Channel or partner marketing experience working with distributors, systems integrators or ecosystem partners.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with senior Sales leaders and influence across complex, matrixed organizations.
* Experience working across Business Units, central marketing functions, partner organizations and external agencies.
* Experience developing and executing integrated regional marketing plans across multiple countries or markets.
* Strong understanding of demand generation and the role of marketing in supporting pipeline progression and revenue growth.
* Working knowledge of digital marketing, including paid media, promotional strategy and social media, with the ability to adapt plans for local markets.
* Experience managing events, including large-scale industry events and on-site execution.
* Strong project management skills with experience coordinating cross-functional teams and external partners across multiple geographies.
* Commercial negotiation skills with the ability to develop effective co-marketing programs with distributors and partners.
* Experience across the UK, Ireland and Nordic markets is highly desirab

jobs.title: Group Communications Lead
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**

A world where complexity is the only constant demands a new breed of company. Brave Bison is a different beast: a media, marketing and technology company purpose built for the digital era.

  

Our universe is made up of award-winning business arms Brave Bison, Engage, SocialChain and MTM. And we’re underpinned by leading marketing training practice, MiniMBA, as well as our very own social-first media network who deliver monthly views in the billions for some of the biggest channels in sport and entertainment across YouTube, Snap, Meta and TikTok.

  

We’re a global collective who live and breathe digital, working with some of the boldest brands in the world to capitalise on the complexity that defines the modern marketing landscape.

**Our mission**

New platforms, new behaviours, new audiences, new trends, new technologies, new regulations: our clients' worlds get more complex daily. Their agency partnerships shouldn't. It's our job to **capitalise on complexity:** cutting through the chaos, making the complex simple and navigating a clear path to growth for them.

**Our values:**

We’re a proudly diverse business comprised of deep specialists across media, marketing, training and technology. Although our skills, backgrounds and beliefs may differ, we are united by four core shared values:

* **Bold Curiosity.**

We run at change and challenge convention because we love to push the boundaries of what the world thinks is possible. We champion discovery, go deep into our clients’ worlds and are always hungry to learn more about them, our specialisms and each other.

  

* **Connected Clarity.**

We are focused in our collaboration — joining the right dots between our clients, our partners and our herd of experts to deliver agile solutions at speed and scale. We set a shared ambition from the outset, are transparent at every stage and always strive to make the complex simple.

  

* **Positive Encouragement.**

We want to make working with us the best part of someone’s day. We lift one other up, find the fun in the day to day and are committed to ensuring everyone belongs.

  

* **Constant Impact.**

We believe in outcomes over outputs. We’re goal orientated, results driven and data-led. We show up with passion every day. And we’re always honing our craft.

**Your role**

We're looking for an experienced and versatile Group Communications Lead to own external and internal communications for Brave Bison as a group, and for each of our business units.

Reporting directly to the CMO and partnering closely with senior leaders across the business, you'll build and protect Brave Bison's reputation across the trade and national press, industry awards and our own channels, while giving every business unit, from MTM to MiniMBA, a clear and consistent industry presence.

You'll manage media relationships, run our awards programme, ghost write for our leadership team, and help keep our people informed and engaged through internal communications.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can write brilliantly, think strategically about reputation, and work comfortably with senior stakeholders across a fast-moving and rapidly-expanding publicly listed company.

To thrive in this role, you’ll be:

* **Strategic:** You’re a big-picture thinker who can think cross-discipline across the entire marketing mix to craft clear compelling narratives that help our specialist businesses stand out in complex, crowded markets.
* **Creative:** a strong copywriter, full of ideas, with the range to flex your writing for different audiences and formats.
* **Organised****:** you have a sharp eye for detail and the project management skills to juggle tight, often overlapping deadlines across multiple business units.
* **Tech-savvy:** You’re across the latest AI and project management tools, and know how to integrate them into team workflows to drive competitive advantage.
* **Collaborative:** You can inspire, align and influence people – both junior and C-suite - across multiple teams and departments.

  

**You’ll have:**

* 5+ years' experience in a communications, PR or marketing role, ideally within media, marketing, technology or entertainment.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with strong editorial judgement and the ability to adapt tone across different businesses, formats and audiences.
* A strong understanding of the marketing, media, sports and HR trade press and awards landscape, with established relationships with key journalists at leading titles and a track record of crafting winning award entries.
* Confidence working with C-suite stakeholders and networking with press.
* Experience writing press releases, bylined articles and internal communications.
* Experience managing an annual awards calendar.
* Experience in a multi-brand agency/business environment is not necessary but a big plus.

  

Every day will be different, but some of your core responsibilities will include:

* Owning Brave Bison's group-wide external communications strategy, working with the CMO and Head of Marketing to build our profile across trade, national and broadcast media.
* Partnering with senior leadership to make sure each business unit's story, from Brave Bison Performance to Engage, Social Chain and the MiniMBA, is told consistently, with clarity and flair.
* Crafting press releases, bylined articles, blogs, case studies and whitepapers on behalf of our agencies
* Directly managing press and media relationships to place news, bylined articles and comments in relevant titles, whilst bringing in external agencies for support as appropriate.
* Identifying and securing speaking and judging opportunities for talent across the group
* Leading Brave Bison's annual awards programme, including drafting, editing and proofreading entries across business units.
* Drafting internal communications, presentations and announcements on behalf of the senior leadership.
* Building and maintaining relationships

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Retire the ERP**
Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.
  
  
We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Fuse Energy.
  
  
We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernise how companies run money, you're in the right place.
  
  
Backed by world-class investors including Balderton and Atomico and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.
  
  
**Finance deserves better**
Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, market or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.
  
  
Light gives them a way out.
  
  
We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:
  
  

* Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.
* Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.
* Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

We take on the ERP and the legacy point solution world with something fast to implement, AI-native from the ground up, and better the more you use it.
  
  
Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée, and teams across Copenhagen, London and Stockholm, with remotes world over.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to join our growth team and open up the channels we haven't really touched yet.
  
  
We've built a lean, efficient demand generation engine on the core paid channels you'd expect at a Series A B2B company, with Google Ads and LinkedIn doing the heavy lifting. It works, and it fills our pipeline every month. Now we want to find the next sources of pipeline, and we need someone who knows how to build them from scratch.
  
  
You'll work alongside our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, VP Marketing and the wider marketing team, with the freedom to test, learn and scale the channels that move the number. You'll sit close to sales, product and design, and you'll own the results of everything you launch.
  
  
We may hire more than one person through this process, so if you go deep on some of these channels rather than all of them, we still want to hear from you.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Building a referral programme that turns happy customers, partners and finance leaders into a steady source of pipeline.
* Running G2 and Capterra campaigns that put Light in front of buyers at the moment they compare options, and turning our reviews into proof across every channel.
* Launching and scaling Meta Ads for B2B, testing creative and audiences until you find what drives qualified pipeline.
* Finding the creators and influencers finance teams follow, writing briefs that land and scaling their content into campaigns that drive pipeline.
* Growing our presence across search and AI answer engines, so that when a finance leader asks Google or ChatGPT about ERP alternatives, Light shows up.
* Setting up measurement for each new channel with RevOps, so we know what every dollar returns.
* Sharing what you learn with the team, doubling down on what works and cutting what doesn't.

**What We Think\* You'll Need**

* Enough years in growth to know how to take a channel from zero to pipeline at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company.
* Hands-on experience across referrals, review sites, Meta Ads, influencer marketing or SEO and GEO. We don't expect you to master all five, so show us where you go deep.
* A test-and-learn mindset, with the discipline to measure every experiment against pipeline and revenue.
* Comfort with numbers and tools, from ad platforms to HubSpot to spreadsheets.
* An eye for creative and a feel for what makes finance people stop scrolling.
* Deep curiosity about how AI is reshaping marketing, finance and the companies we serve.
* A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant assholes here, please.
* If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don't tick every box, we'd still love for you to reach out and convince us you're the right person.

**The Good Stuff**

* A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in Copenhagen.
* A competitive salary and potential stock options.
* 25 days of annual leave plus public holidays in the country where you're based.
* Regular socials and two company offsites a year.
* The chance to build new growth channels from the ground up at a company defining a new category.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
**The Famous Last Words**
We've proven the core of our growth engine works. Now we want to see how far it can go, and we want you to build the parts we haven't tried yet. If you love starting channels from scratch and watching them turn into pipeline, let's talk.

jobs.title: Marketing Lead - Content & Product Marketing
jobs.description:
**The company**

Grasp exists to turn time online into capability. We think the best learning format ever devised is the tutorial system: one guide who curates reading lists worth your time, and sessions with real push-back where you can’t hide. It’s been reserved for a few thousand people a year at Oxford and Cambridge. We’re rebuilding it in software, for anyone with an internet connection, $6 a month, and the effort to use them.

The product today curates the best of the open internet and interleaves it with exercises that don’t let you pretend to know. We have a growing base of paying learners and investors who use the product themselves.

We’re a team of six. Everyone here taught themselves most of what they use at work, from deep learning to product strategy, and that’s the skill we’re trying to pass on. Half the team spent years at Revolut and we share investors, including one of its cofounders. We’ve kept the working style: small team, high bar, everyone hands-on, ship and correct fast.

**The role**

You’d be our first marketer, focused on product marketing and content. There is a product people pay for, a team that will build whatever measurement you need, and an audience of self-directed learners who are already out there figuring things out on their own. You’ll keep finding places they spend time and talk to them there.

In the first quarter that means owning how we talk to learners from content and landing through onboarding, and starting alternative channels to grow the audience on. Then it means growing the ones that work.

This isn’t the job if you want a single brief and a calendar or a team to delegate to.

**Requirements**

**Essential**

3+ years doing consumer marketing with conversion copywriting results you can show us.

You’ve done audience research and turned it into a messaging hierarchy that product and growth leveraged successfully.

You’ve personally built and grown at least 1 social channel from scratch.

You’re comfortable being a voice in public, or producing someone else’s.

You’ve turned customers or followers into advocates before, and can tell us who they were and what happened.

You extensively leverage frontier AI in your workflow, and can illustrate how.

**Desirable**

You’ve run multi-channel content calendars and a repurposing pipeline.

You’ve produced content with experts/founders on camera.

You know lifecycle comms.

You can read a channel-by-channel signup breakdown and know what to do with it.

You’ve built communities and other lighthouses (we have WhatsApp groups and quite a serious AI paper club you can build up).

You know the adult self-learning audience, or you’re one of them.

**How you work**

You prioritise. Time and resources go where they move the number, and you can ELI5 why.

You have grit. It can be high volume and fast paced. You don’t expect your work to be comfortable.

You hustle. You try things, run tests, and fix problems as they appear, without waiting to be told how.

You’re organised. You can lead an initiative end to end: set the goal, build the tracker, hit the date.

**Compensation & Benefits**

£50k–£85k, plus stock options. Negotiable salary-to-equity mix.

Unlimited frontier AI access + whatever tools you need.

Unlimited Grasp for you and two friends.

As the first marketer you will work directly with the founders to build the system you need.

Small team in Canary Wharf.

Deliveroo for when you’re in late.

Communications Manager | Global Communications
  
  
Permanent | Full-time | Monday to Friday | 40-hours | Hybrid (Home | London or Bracknell)
  
  
**Help tell the story behind the people, change and innovation that bring extraordinary content to life.**
At NEP Group, we work behind the scenes of some of the world’s most exciting live productions, broadcast moments, sporting events and entertainment. Our global network spans 25 countries and more than 5,000 employees, supporting productions around the world.
  
  
Now we’re looking for an experienced
**Communications Manager**
to join our Global Communications team.
  
  
This is not a role where you’ll simply take a brief and pass it on.
  
  
You’ll shape the approach, develop the ideas, write the content and help deliver communications that make a difference.
  
  
For your first 12 months, you’ll play a key role in communicating business transformation across NEP, alongside a broad mix of employee engagement and executive communications. You’ll also contribute to priority external corporate communications, with plenty of scope for the role to evolve as our business does.
  
  
**What You’ll Get Involved In**
**Bring change to life**
Turn complex transformation and change into communications that people can understand, connect with and act on. You’ll create communication plans, messaging, FAQs, leader toolkits, presentations and other content that makes change clearer and more meaningful.
  
  
**Create employee communications people actually want to read**
Tell the stories behind our successes, strategy and progress through engaging newsletters, intranet content and business updates, adapting the message for colleagues working across different countries, roles and environments.
  
  
**Work closely with senior leaders**
Help bring town halls, leadership videos, podcasts, presentations, scripts and talking points to life, finding creative ways to make executive communications relevant and accessible to employees wherever they work.
  
  
**Shape high-profile corporate content**
Support our global communications and marketing leadership on corporate, product and commercially important communications and content.
  
  
**Own your work from idea to delivery**
You’ll manage projects end-to-end, bringing together stakeholders, creative colleagues and subject-matter experts across businesses and geographies while keeping momentum, quality and deadlines firmly on track.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
You’re an experienced communications professional who enjoys being both strategic and hands-on.
  
  
You can take a complicated subject, find the story within it and turn it into clear, compelling communications. You’re equally comfortable building a communications plan, interviewing a subject-matter expert, writing for a senior leader, coordinating a major employee update or managing multiple projects at once.
  
  
**You’ll Bring**

* 8+ years’ experience across internal, corporate, executive or related communications.
* Experience working in a complex, global or matrixed organisation with multiple time-zones.
* Hands-on experience communicating business transformation or organisational change.
* Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complexity into clear, engaging content.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to move several pieces of work forward at the same time.
* Confidence working with stakeholders at different levels, functions and locations.
* Good judgement, attention to detail and discretion when working with sensitive or evolving information.
* The independence to get things moving, combined with the instinct to collaborate when it matters.

Experience communicating with both field-based and desk-based employees, supporting senior leaders, or working in broadcast, live production, sport, entertainment or live events would be a real advantage.
  
  
**Why NEP?**
Our people help make and deliver incredible content around the world. From broadcast and live events to virtual production, our teams combine technical expertise, innovation and collaboration to help our clients bring their content to life.
  
  
Our values are Reliable, Ethical, Innovative and One Team, and they shape how we work with our clients and with each other.
  
  
For a communicator, that creates something special, NEP is a global business with fascinating stories to tell, meaningful change underway and an audience that spans countries, cultures, functions and ways of working.
  
  
If you love finding clarity in complexity, turning strategy into stories and creating communications that help people understand where a business is going, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Ready to bring great communications to life? Apply now. Closing dates for applications is Sunday 22 November 2026.**
*Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close the advert early if we receive a high volume of great applications, so if you're interested, we’d love to see your application sooner rather than later!*

We help enterprises in financial services, media and entertainment, telecoms, retail and gaming build data platforms and activate agentic AI on Google Cloud. The team works from London, Stockholm and North America.

Our GTM Marketing team turns that work into pipeline: executive dinners and roundtables, account-based campaigns for our key accounts, joint marketing with Google, and the content and data that support sales.

**The role**

As Marketing Manager, you will own Datatonic's field marketing, account-based marketing and marketing operations in the UK and Europe, turning our GTM strategy into events and campaigns that create pipeline, while also ensuring effective reporting and data-driven insights for the team. You will plan and run executive events, run ABM programmes for named accounts alongside sales, and make sure every lead and opportunity is tracked and reported in Salesforce. You will use AI tools every day to plan, create and measure your work faster, and innovate on what’s possible.

**In your first year, success looks like:**

* A 2027 events calendar delivered on budget, with leads followed up and attributed in Salesforce
* ABM programmes running for priority accounts, with marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline reported monthly
* Paid social and email campaigns that hit agreed lead targets
* Strong working relationships with sales pods, Google Cloud marketing and our agencies

**What you'll do**

**Events and field marketing**

* Plan and run the events calendar: executive dinners, roundtables, workshops, sponsored conferences and Google Cloud events in the UK and Europe
* Own each event end to end: brief, audience targeting, invitations, agency and venue logistics, on-the-day delivery and follow-up with sales
* Brief and manage event agencies and sponsorship partners, holding them to registration and attendance targets
* Build the annual events plan and budget and report return on each event
* Build a strong working relationship with the sales team, ensuring support and collaboration for commercial success

**Account-based marketing**

* Run 1:1 and 1:few ABM programmes for priority accounts, working with account leads in our industry pods
* Create account plans, direct mail, email sequences and LinkedIn campaigns for named buying groups
* Report engagement and pipeline for each account at pod and account syncs

Paid and digital channels

* Plan, run and optimise LinkedIn paid campaigns, including budget, targeting and creative briefs
* Build email campaigns and segmentation in Salesforce

**Marketing operations and reporting**

* Own marketing reporting: build and maintain the reports and dashboards for leads, campaign performance and marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline
* Report performance weekly and monthly against targets, and turn the numbers into clear recommendations for the team and leadership
* Keep campaign, lead and contact data clean in Salesforce, and follow the contact-to-opportunity process with sales
* Manage marketing tools and vendor spend

**Partners and team**

* Run joint marketing with Google Cloud and other partners
* Coach and give day-to-day guidance to junior marketers on the team

**AI in your day-to-day**

* Use AI tools (such as Gemini and Claude) daily for research, copy, event briefs, campaign assets and analysis
* Build your own no-code marketing agents to continuously improve and innovate on how marketing functions
* Find new ways to use AI to save the team time, and share what works

**What you'll bring**

* Minimum 5+ years in B2B marketing, ideally in technology, consulting or professional services
* A track record of running executive events, roundtables and large scale conferences from brief to follow-up, with the pipeline to show for it
* Experience running ABM programmes with sales teams for enterprise accounts
* Hands-on LinkedIn Ads experience, including budgets, targeting and reporting
* Strong Salesforce skills: building your own reports and dashboards, not just reading them, as well as running campaigns, lists and email
* Confidence turning data into insight: spotting what is working and recommending what to change
* Daily, hands-on use of AI tools and agentic workflows in your work, with examples of how they made you faster or better
* Experience managing agencies, vendors and budgets
* Clear writing for senior audiences: invitations, briefs and follow-up emails
* Organised and calm when running several campaigns at once

**Nice to have**

* Experience marketing with Google Cloud or another partner programme
* Knowledge of data and AI services, or of selling to CTOs and CDOs
* Experience in our key industries: financial services, media and entertainment, telecoms, retail or gaming
* Experience running events outside the UK, for example in the Nordics
* Comfort with Figma or similar tools for event and campaign assets

**Team and location**

You will report to the Head of Marketing in the GTM Marketing team, working closely with sales pods, partnerships and Google Cloud marketing. The role is based at our London office with regular office days and some travel for events.

At Revlon, we create beauty innovations for everyone that inspire confidence and ignite joy every day.
  
  
Breaking beauty boundaries is in our company’s DNA. Since its game-changing launch of the first opaque nail enamel in 1932 (and later, the first long-wear foundation), Revlon has provided consumers with high-quality product innovation, performance, and sophisticated glamour. Elizabeth Arden made waves as a woman-led beauty company in the 1920s. In 1931, Almay became the original hypoallergenic, fragrance-free beauty brand.
  
  
Today, Revlon resiliently continues its legacy as a leading global beauty company. Our diverse portfolio—which consists of some of the world’s most iconic brands and product offerings in color cosmetics, skincare, hair color & care, personal care, and fragrances—is sold around the world through prestige, professional, mass, and direct-to-consumer retail channels. These brands include Revlon, Revlon Professional, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, American Crew, CND, Cutex, Mitchum, Sinful Colors, Creme of Nature, Christina Aguilera, John Varvatos, Juicy Couture, Ed Hardy and more.
  
  
We honor our heritage, embrace change, and applaud diversity. We champion our employees and celebrate our consumers.
  
  
We are Revlon, together, transforming beauty.
  
  
**This role is a Hybrid Role:**
Employees are expected to work from our London office 3 days per week and may work remotely the remaining days.

A Brand Champion for the Revlon Professional and American Crew portfolio, responsible for driving omni-channel growth across salons, wholesalers (B2B), pro-retail and e-commerce B2C) in the UKI market. The role bridges global brand strategy with local commercial execution, owning trade activation, in-store excellence and 360° consumer campaigns to accelerate visibility, conversion and sell-out in a fast-scaling retail and B2C landscape.

Design and deliver omni-channel trade activation plans across B2B and B2C customers, maximizing sell-out, loyalty and market share.

* Lead the development and execution of Point of Sale, Visual and Merchandising solutions, ensuring consistent, premium brand presence across direct and indirect customers.
* Brief and manage agencies to deliver clear, effective assets on time and within customer timelines.
* Track performance and ROI of trade activity, translating insights into optimization plans.

**Pro-Retail & E-Commerce Growth:**
Drive growth of pro-retail and e-commerce as strategic omni-channel levers for recruitment, visibility and conversion.
  
  

* Lead trade marketing and e-trade strategies with key partners (e.g. Boots, Tesco, Savers, e-tailers), spanning in-store and digital touchpoints.
* Own merchandising strategies including shelf layouts, planograms, permanent and promotional displays, and seasonal activations.
* Develop, localize and optimize PDP content (copy, visuals, claims, SEO) ensuring data accuracy and best-in-class execution across platforms.
* Monitor performance KPIs (traffic, conversion, rankings, sell-out) and recommend growth-driving actions.

**Brand Campaigns & NPD Execution:**
Lead 360° omni-channel campaigns driving end-consumer engagement and retailer conversion across in-store, Retailer.com, OOH and sampling.
  
  

* Act as project lead across Sales, Demand Planning, Digital Marketing, Education and agency partners.
* Own local NPD execution, including launch support, SKU transitions and planogram updates, ensuring strong sell-in readiness.
* Equip Sales teams with clear NPD updates and presentation materials to support commercial success. Management of trade, PR and press sampling

**Commercial & Operational Ownership:**
Full accountability for Brand Support / A&M budgets, including activity P&Ls, PO management and ROI tracking.
  
  

* Present clear overviews of activity plans, investment & performance to internal stakeholder & external customers.

* Manage vendor relationships, SAP process, product data, local stock forecasts to ensure operational excellence.

* Proven delivery of in-store execution, e-trade content and integrated campaigns.
